observations: Five differently sized spaces replace the repeated four-room arrangement.
Ten physical connections include separate lower/middle and middle/upper links between two room pairs.
Two independent lower-to-middle Turbine ascents feed partial galleries; the third floor is local to Turbine and Relay.
Lower and middle outer routes allow travel around the main atrium.
Final XY compression preserves all 16-unit stair rises and 33-34-unit treads.
Sampled sightlines shortened and all spawn eye pairs are screened, but runtime safety is unverified.
hypotheses_pending_runtime: Unequal room shapes and staggered approaches make route choices easier to distinguish.
A second ascent limits control from a single middle landing.
The separate upper Turbine-Relay link creates useful armor counterplay.
Quad on the Loading mezzanine pulls traffic toward the east bypass without concentrating all major-item control.
next_controlled_variants: Remove only the second Turbine ascent.
Close only the upper Turbine-Relay connection.
Move only Quad to a lower Loading position.
new_unrelated_issue: Quality graph timing omits intra-area approach distance and may be zero for distinct anchors on the same node. Correct and verify endpoint costs before treating timing as a ranking objective.
